title: Design exercise: SAA-2.2-S02
scenario: Cinderford Health Rota schedules nurses for two hospital sites, each served mainly from a different AWS Region, and staff at both sites edit shift records all day. Each record is looked up by staff ID and date, with no joins. Clinical governance requires that losing any one data center in a Region causes no visible outage, and that losing an entire Region still leaves both sites able to read and edit rosters within minutes. A 2 TB archive of signed rota PDFs must also exist in both Regions, and the application tier is already stateless.
constraints: Do not claim live AWS experience
Both sites must be able to write during normal operation, not only after a failover
The small platform team cannot operate custom replication code

rubric.label: The data tier accepts writes in both Regions
Each layer (compute, data, archive, DNS) survives the loss of one data center and of one whole Region

constraint_reason: Mapped as design_exercise to complete skill coverage when no dedicated live lab step exists
